checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-provenance.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" provenance --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'Write and read optional evidence relationships' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'mine-session' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'trace' "$tmp/help"; "$tmp/ao" provenance add --help >"$tmp/addhelp"; grep -Fq 'ao provenance add <from-id> <to-id>' "$tmp/addhelp"; grep -Fq 'wasGeneratedBy' "$tmp/addhelp"; work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-provenance-run.XXXXXX); ( cd "$work"; "$tmp/ao" provenance list >"$tmp/list"; grep -Fq 'no provenance edges' "$tmp/list"; "$tmp/ao" provenance list --json >"$tmp/listjson"; grep -Fq '[]' "$tmp/listjson"; "$tmp/ao" provenance verify >"$tmp/verify"; grep -Fq 'OK: provenance ledger chain intact' "$tmp/verify"; "$tmp/ao" provenance position >"$tmp/pos"; grep -Fq 'provenance ledger is empty' "$tmp/pos" )
